confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, with remembered prices brought forward to July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given summer demand swings. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship (about 3x and 2x the beer anchor) because direct bar-pricing knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search summaries of RBA pages, not an opened RBA page, so verify it against the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Loosely benchmarked against Seoul, Tokyo and Hong Kong: restaurant meals and mid-range hotels sit at the lower end of that group, while cafe, beer and cocktail prices are closer to Seoul levels.
